sources.mechanism_claim: Bollinger-band distance is a statistical deviation measure; it is not itself proof of unconditional single-asset reversal alpha.
sources.implementation_lesson: use standardized deviation as a proxy and require an explicit reverting regime plus confirmation/invalidation
sources.limitations: statistical/pairs framing differs from BingX perpetual single-asset execution

sources.mechanism_claim: Bitcoin exhibited short-horizon negative first-order autocorrelation in the studied sample, with stronger reversal after larger moves.
sources.implementation_lesson: condition the candidate on move magnitude and use a causal time-stop rather than oscillator-only reversal
sources.limitations: historical sample; not current BingX promotion evidence

sources.mechanism_claim: BTC/USDT Bollinger breakout versus mean-reversion behavior is regime dependent; mean reversion degrades in sustained directional phases.
sources.implementation_lesson: make trend/regime blocking explicit and treat band excursion as conditional, not universal, reversal evidence
sources.limitations: retrospective BTC/USDT study; no authority over ZEL parameters or alpha

architecture.economic_mechanism: temporary overreaction/liquidity-demand imbalance can move price away from a local equilibrium; only a confirmed reclaim in a non-trending state is eligible for a reversion hypothesis
architecture.payer_constraint: urgent liquidity takers and leveraged overshoot may pay the reversion edge after temporary displacement; hypothesis only
architecture.observable_entry_event: previous closed bar settles outside a 20-bar two-standard-deviation envelope and the next closed bar reclaims inside that envelope in the opposite direction
architecture.direction: long after lower-band reclaim; short after upper-band reclaim
architecture.regime_no_trade: block when normalized slow trend slope is too large, source is stale, move-to-equilibrium cannot cover frozen cost budget, or band width/variance is invalid
architecture.invalidation: stop beyond the excursion extreme by frozen ATR geometry; no adverse averaging or DCA rescue
architecture.target_exit: primary target is the frozen local mean; time-stop if reversion does not occur within 8 bars; no evaluator-invented exit
architecture.risk_sizing: fixed equity-risk fraction with notional cap; risk distance comes from policy stop geometry
architecture.partial_trailing_runner: disabled in v2 because the mechanism is equilibrium reversion rather than trend capture
architecture.turnover: one new intent per confirmed reclaim event; cooldown 2 bars after intent
architecture.expected_move_cost_budget: entry-to-midline distance must be >=1.5x verified round-trip cost before the policy may emit a tradable intent
architecture.whole_architecture_falsification: prospective net reversion must beat direction-flip, time-placebo, regime-permutation and delayed-entry controls under identical frozen source/window/cost lineage; otherwise reject v2
architecture.source_method_fidelity: v2 intentionally removes legacy RSI/EMA voting and adverse adds; standardized band excursion is only a deviation proxy, while regime blocking, reclaim confirmation, risk geometry and cost budget are separately owned
